key_insight: An agentic AI pipeline combines environmental data and health evidence to answer neighborhood-specific environmental health questions in the Salt Lake Valley.
clinical_relevance: The system could help residents and health providers contextualize local weather and air quality using asthma-related guidance, but clinical benefit was not established.
method: Used LangGraph and OpenAI models to interpret questions and orchestrate external tools.
Integrated weather, air-quality, geospatial, and neighborhood environmental data with retrieval of asthma-related clinical guidance.
Added fallback mechanisms for unavailable external services.
evidence_signal: A curated question benchmark assessed tool use, parameter mapping, analytic pathways, and response grounding; the partial abstract reports generally strong performance but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Benchmark performance does not establish real-world reliability or improved health outcomes.
paper_title: An Agentic AI Pipeline for an Evidence-Grounded Environmental Health Public Information System: Development and Evaluation
